verdict.rationale: Gmail documents deleting emails with Gemini ('Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails'), and its API lets you manage mailbox data such as threads and messages. That is real, product-native deletion control, but nothing in the pack covers retention. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or auto-deletion policies, controls over how long Gemini/AI-processed data is kept, account-level data deletion or export guarantees, and any independent corroboration.
